CheckVersion.description: The version of a model check report, its `schema` field.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

description:
The report of a model check: `crn-craft.rules-check/0.1`.

It covers rules-model/0.1 to 0.3 documents. The check stops at the first stage that fails (parsing, size limits, names and types, then the rest of the model), so `diagnostics` lists the errors of that stage.

diagnostics.description: Errors with stable codes and JSON Pointer paths into the model: `CRN-E001` to `CRN-E004` from parsing, `CRN-R010` to `CRN-R015` from validation, `CRN-E030` for an unreadable file.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model bytes, when they could be read.

valid.description: True when the model parses and compiles without diagnostics.

title: RulesCheck
